'''''Raptor''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used by the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. ''Raptor'' was commanded by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Breck]] and in about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the Black Sun [[Vigo/Legends|vigo]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] arranged for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] to be transported from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] to the [[Space station/Legends|installation]] [[Kantaros Station]] aboard ''Raptor'', to which the vessel was set to deliver a cargo of illicit goods. However, when Xizor learned that the [[Whiplash]]&mdash;a resistance group that Pavan was affiliated with&mdash;planned to [[Attack on the Emperor's Villa|attack]] the Imperial leader [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Xizor canceled ''Raptor''{{'s}} assignment and ordered the vessel to stand down, because he did not want the Empire to suspect that Black Sun was having dealings with the rebels. However, the Whiplash-affiliated [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[I-5YQ]] stole ''Raptor''{{'s}} identification codes and the Whiplash [[Helix-class light interceptor|''Helix''-class light interceptor]] ''[[Laranth]]'' subsequently traveled to Kantaros Station while masquerading as ''Raptor''.
